record.question: Rewriting the directory structure or file system of a disk is called:
record.explanation: Answer C: Formatting. Formatting rewrites the disk’s file-system/directory structures; that is the correct choice. Reference: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/storage/disk-management/overview-of-disk-management. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
